'A 100% buy-today-read-tonight delight' LEE CHILD

A serial killer is terrifying Oslo, staging shocking murders inspired by iconic movie scenes. And Harry Hole is about to be given a starring role.

A murderer is stalking Oslo.

Each killing recreates an iconic movie scene, each one more shocking than the last.

All evidence leads towards the city’s biggest film set, but the man with the expertise to stop the killer is no longer a detective.

Oleg, Harry’s stepson, is investigating the murders, and Harry knows he should keep his distance.
Though it’s not always easy to stay out of the frame . . .As Harry is drawn back into helping his old team, the lines between his professional instincts and his personal life begin to blur.

With the body count rising, and the killer one step ahead, Harry and Oleg are under pressure to crack the case.

But the killer is saving the best scene for last.

Kill Shot is the heart-racing new Detective Hole thriller with an explosive FINAL TWIST that will leave readers reeling.

**HARRY HOLE IS NOW A MAJOR NETFLIX TV SERIES - DETECTIVE HOLE**
